build_slack_manifest: build a full Slack app manifest JSON with display info, OAuth scopes, and slash commands
build_slack_manifest_custom_name: build a Slack manifest with a custom bot name and description for the Hermes agent
generate_slack_manifest_cli: generate and print a Slack app manifest JSON to stdout using the hermes CLI
write_slack_manifest_to_file: write a Slack manifest JSON to a file using the hermes slack manifest --write flag
generate_slash_commands_only: generate only the slash commands array from the Slack manifest for merging into an existing config
